subject: history
concept: Applying modern world knowledge to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile, and connecting history to the present
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates a connection between a studied historical event and something happening in the world today
exercise.abstract: Student explains this connection in a short written response

assessment.mastery_threshold: connection is genuine and historically grounded, not superficial
misconception_flags: draws a connection with no real historical grounding or logical link

interest_binding: connection topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
